en: Time to put your shoes on! But wait... which foot goes in first? Do you know?
<SAW> taught us a lovely sunnah for our shoes.
When you put your shoes on, start with the right foot!
And when you take your shoes off, start with the left foot.
The right foot goes in first, and comes out last!
Let's practise! Right shoe on, then the left. Left shoe off, then the right.
Can you do it today? Say: Right foot first!
voice_fix_note: lines 0 and 1 re-voiced (variants 0 and 3 of jobs/2026-11-12_kids_fix.json): 'Shoes on' heard as 'Choose on', 'sunnah' as 'sooner'. Line 4: 'So,' trimmed off the start of the clip (whisper heard 'So' as 'No' in the mix; second reviewer flagged it); remaining audio heard as 'The right foot goes in first and comes out last.'
